notes.title: Full Release !
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41318694/c4ab04506e8bd6cfa5241134e4082ca11288af7d.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hello everyone.[/h1]

[h2]A nice little monkey who will train you for the tournaments has just been published as the full version.[/h2]

We have improved the mechanics.
We fixed the bugs.
We added new content.

All these thanks to your support and exciting ideas.

Desktop Monkey will continue to be developed so if you have any ideas I would love to hear them.

Thank you for all your support.

Enjoy :D

3DM

notes.title: The new challenge is now ready.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41318694/fb7cf6474bcdb6218a7e0eae0310d6f17f980ee8.jpg[/img]

[h2]Our newest game DESKTOP MONKEY is now available.[/h2]

Take part in tournaments for which a little monkey who will live on your screen will prepare you.

The game is demanding, so you have to develop and use new and better techniques of cutting food.

We have prepared thematic trainings and a tournament for you and your best results will be visible on the global Steam lists.

We've been working on this game a lot of time but we are a small group of enthusiasts so we decided to release the game in Early Access.

Amendments and new tournaments with new tables will be added periodically. New content coming soon.

Please report any bugs here on Steam or on our Discord under the DESKTOP MONKEY category.

[b]OUR DISCORD LINK:[/b]
https://discord.com/invite/ttU6CjSP

[h2]Thank you for all your support. Thanks to you, this game has been greatly improved and now it will only get better. Thank you.[/h2]

If you want to support a tiny team, please take part in the competition and achieve high results.

[h2]Who will be the best? [/h2]

Good Luck!

3DM Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41318694/257243daad7758f340073b34df18c9120f0f20a9.png[/img]
